tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Conducting Multiphase Engineering Investigation of internal condition assessment of Left Bank earthen part of of Hidkal Dam.

itemList.description: Electrical Resistivity Imaging Multi-electrode Conducting a non-destructive Electrical Resistivity Imaging (ERI) using multi-electrode array and plotting 2D resistivity profiles to assess subsurface anomalies, water seepage zones, and structural inconsistencies. Includes: Line-level survey alignment and ERI grid setup.Including survey team all survey equipment, accessories, and safety gear including transportation, loading, unloading, set up.etc complete
Streaming Potential - Carrying out Streaming Potential Survey  to further assess the direction and velocity of underground seepage flow across the dam structure.

MASW - 2D Performing 2D MASW survey along dam cross-sections to generate shear wave velocity tomograms and evaluate soil/rock stiffness profiles to identify potential zones of weakness.And also preparing the reports as per survey with documents and photograps.The reports  must be certified from the expert from IIT. and expert review is to be attached at the time of submission of report.
